note: Leaf reads 'cum sief viridi, & sief de chalcātho' and 'sebel, & scabiei', 'in oculū'; X has 'cum fiet viridi, & fiet de chalcatho', 'sebeli, & scabei', 'in oculo', which garbles the remedy's name.
X's Greek column is garbled, drops the line 'διηγεῖτο δὲ ὅμως, ὡς ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ πρὸς αὐτὸν' and inserts line numbers; its Latin also omits 'uiam' in 'in hora uiam quinque milium annorum'.
The leaf has only mirror-reversed show-through of the title page; Y transcribes that other side's title ('BREVIARIUM ROMANUM … M. DC. XCVI.') as if it were this page's text.
Footnote 10 prints 'Id. οὔπω' (a variant); Y gives 'οὕτω', the same as the main text, which voids the variant note. Y also has 'Infinitiois'.
The texts differ only in how abbreviations are handled ('theatrum'/'theatrū', 'idque'/'idq;'); the wording is identical.
Leaf reads 'eum seruemus uictum'; X has 'eum qui huic uictum'. X's margins misread 'discrimen' as 'differre' and 'hec ex controuersia mirabilis' as 'haec est conseruatiua mirabilis'.
X drops 'uir' in 'quod uir matris opianicus ei parauisset', gives 'libras ccliii' for the printed 'cccliii', and 'quod gallicum' for 'per quendam gallicum'.
The page number is printed '3785' (continuous pagination, with a fraktur 5); X gives '378'. Otherwise X only normalises spellings ('Erzhirt' for 'Ertzhirt').

X is largely garbled and invents headings ('Incipit de arte nova', 'Exordium de arte nova'); Y follows the leaf, e.g. 'hel, y, gamaze, azatan, hemel, samuetheon' and 'Restant nota que non possunt aliquo modo exponi'.
X drops 'Tussiētes medicat̃ bibita vsqz ad .ʒ.i.' and puts an invented 'Auicē.' in its place; X also misdescribes the iris-like woodcut.
